subject: history
concept: Understanding the Cold War as a period of tension between major world powers without direct large-scale war between them
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines a simplified map showing which nations aligned with which side during this period
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a Cold War event or symbol to what it represented
exercise.abstract: Student explains, at a basic level, why this period was called a 'cold' war

misconception_flags: confuses the Cold War with a direct large-scale war between the two major powers

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
